faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about Rojgar Matrix.
faq_a1: Rojgar Matrix is an AI-powered job marketplace that connects job seekers and employers directly via WhatsApp and Call, making hiring faster and easier in India.
faq_q2: How do I apply for a job?
faq_a2: Simply browse the latest job listings, click on 'Apply via WhatsApp', and you will be redirected to the employer's chat to start a direct conversation instantly.
faq_q3: Is Rojgar Matrix free to use?
faq_a3: Browsing and basic job applications are free. We also offer advanced AI features like Resume Refinement and Mock Interviews through a transparent credit-based system.
faq_a4: Credits are used to unlock premium AI tools. You can recharge your wallet with standard or professional packs in your profile section to use these advanced features.
faq_q5: Can employers post jobs for free?
faq_a5: Yes, employers can register and post jobs to reach thousands of candidates. We also provide featured listing and promotion options to get maximum visibility.
faq_q6: Can I use AI to improve my resume?
faq_a6: Yes! You can use our AI Resume tool to optimize your summary and skills for better matching with job requirements.
faq_a7: Yes, we take security seriously and follow industry standards to ensure your data is protected and private.
faq_q8: What happens if I don't get a job match?
faq_a8: We continuously refine our AI algorithms to improve matching. You can also update your profile for better visibility to employers.
